brief:
Eyal Weizman, director of Forensic Architecture, has released a new book examining the physical destruction of Gaza as part of Israel's genocide against Palestinians, Democracy Now! reported. "Ungrounding: The Architecture of Genocide" investigates how the territory's built environment has been systematically destroyed and the consequences for Palestinian inhabitants.

Weizman's work applies forensic analysis to document what he characterizes as a permanent architecture of control imposed on Gaza through the destruction of its physical infrastructure.
dek: We speak with Forensic Architecture’s Eyal Weizman about his new book, Ungrounding: The Architecture of Genocide , a meticulous investigation into Israel’s genocide in Gaza, the physical destruction of the territory and its impact on the Palestinian people.
title: Israeli architect documents Gaza's physical destruction as genocide infrastructure
